title: Mikasa's visual world
question: Round 2. The roll assigned The Reading Room. Keep it, take an alternate, the pick, the canon, or re-roll.

options.label: The Reading Room
options.lineage: the members' library reading room after hours: brass lamps, deep green leather, hushed shelves
options.thesis: Studying in a great library at night: your course is an open volume on the desk, the room stays quiet around it. It refuses the card-dashboard SaaS look and the gamified app look at once.
options.viewport: The desk holds one open volume at reading scale: the course, its contents page showing Modules as chapter heads and Lessons as numbered entries. Completed entries carry an inked date stamp, the next carries a brass marker. The Tutor annotates in pencil in the outer margin; the Tailor proposes a re-catalogued page you approve before it is bound in.
options.risk: Heritage kitsch if leather, brass, and stamps are costume instead of structure; also flirts with the cream-plus-serif default the category overuses, so the grammar has to carry the difference.

raised.raise: Absence is drawn as deliberately as light: lessons not yet generated sit as ruled ghost entries, visible empty slots in the contents.
One invisible module disciplines every placement, so a Tailor rearrangement re-flows the page without breaking it.
Inactive furniture drops to ash gray while structure holds; nothing ever disappears, it de-tensions.
Tone comes from ink density, not color: progress shades the page like pressure on a pencil, not badges.

options.signature: Finishing an Exercise stamps the entry with the date, as a library due-stamp settling into the paper; the chapter head recounts its entries in small caps.

options.label: The Night Plot
options.lineage: a navigation chart table under red night light
options.thesis: Learning as plotting a passage: the Goal is the destination, Modules are legs, Lessons are waypoints, and your progress is drawn onto the chart as you travel.
options.viewport: The course chart spans the workspace: a drawn route from origin to destination port, legs labeled with module names, waypoints as lesson marks. Red instrument light keeps the room dark; the leg you are on burns brightest.
options.risk: Nautical costume on a landlocked product; the route drawing has to do real navigational work or it is a themed progress bar.

options.label: Midnight Transit
options.lineage: metropolitan rail diagrams as midnight-blue enamel murals
options.thesis: The course as a transit network: Modules are colored lines, Lessons are stations, the Goal is the destination terminus, and interchanges are where topics connect.
options.viewport: The course network fills the workspace on midnight-blue enamel: your line lit brightest, traveled stations filled, the destination named at the terminus.
options.case: Nearly beats the room: the destination-first grammar matches Goal-shaped courses exactly, and midnight blue stays calm. It loses identification narrowly; libraries are the learner's own world, enamel murals are a commute they admire.
options.risk: Line-color saturation hard to keep quiet; weak for long-form reading, which needs a page, not a map.

options.label: The Cyc
options.lineage: theater cyclorama lit from black night through cobalt and rose to white day
options.thesis: The workspace as a lit stage wall: depthless dark ground, a low horizon band carrying structure, and each finished module brings the scene one phase closer to day.
options.viewport: Content sits in horizontal horizon bands stacked dark to light; the lesson you are reading sits in the fully lit band, the untouched course still in black below.
options.case: Holds identification through the evening-to-day arc matching a learner's own progress, but state-as-light alone fails clarity: light phases are labeled, never color-only, and reading needs firmer edges than a gradient wall.
options.risk: Atmosphere outrunning legibility; long prose on a lit cyc tires the eye.

options.label: Seven-Segment
options.lineage: bedside clocks, price totems, scoreboard panels
options.case: Fuses badly: a fixed cell mask counts well but cannot carry prose, and its registers are appliance, not study.
options.kept: Absence drawn as deliberately as light: unlit ghost cells for what remains.

options.label: ASCII Render
options.lineage: live scenes rendered as typewriter characters
options.case: Fuses badly: glyph-density imagery is a medium flex with no purchase on curriculum structure.

options.label: Modular Identity
options.lineage: Dutch postmodern identity systems: photos and saturated bars snapped to a module
options.case: Fuses badly: loud block grammar sits against the calm-polished brief at every step.
options.kept: The invisible module: everything snaps, so rearrangement never breaks composition.

options.label: Tensegrity Column
options.lineage: carbon-rod tensegrity sculptures breathing under red cord
options.case: Fuses badly: force-network topology is engineer poetry with no learner picture.
options.kept: Slack members go ash gray while structure holds.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What every focused learning tool ships: clean neutral surface, workhorse sans, one blue accent, card dashboard. Executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar with course list, content cards on a neutral ground, primary button in accent blue.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design; that is the point of the canon.
